author: NamelessAstral
quote: This may well be a polished commercial product, but the thing I feared most has happened anyway: Dan Houser’s departure really did strip GTA 6 of its soul. I cannot accept that this industrial junk—narrative and character writing flattened into hollow emptiness and papered over with graphics and sheer content volume—is the GTA we waited thirteen years for.Photorealistic game graphics are the least valuable thing a game can have. Over time, the visuals that once stunned you fade into nothing. Look back over the last ten or even twenty years: of the games that first hit you with their graphics, how many still hold up today? Only the ones that got by on a distinctive art style have a chance, and the GTA series is clearly not among them.Pouring resources into a game to pile on content is a way to show industrial muscle. It does not set the game’s tone, and it does not give the game a soul.What actually decides whether a game hits me, stays with me, and makes me think “this is a great game” every time I look back, even wanting to recommend it to friends and family, can only be the story, the direction, and the characters.Unfortunately, the opening of this game decides in advance that you must have a lover, not to mention that she's a stupid good-for-nothing.I can accept that I cannot freely shape the character I play the way I can in Cyberpunk 2077, Fallout, or The Elder Scrolls. That has always been GTA’s tradition. What I refuse is being handed such a central intimate relationship as a given—and you even have a child. I have to say this is nothing like Fallout 4. There, the player’s spouse is background, and the child is just a reason and a motive. In GTA 6, the entire main story revolves around that relationship, and it brings a pile of restrictions I cannot accept: you can’t do this, you can’t do that. So constrained. Is this still GTA? Even the ending is affected by the Criminal Profile. That is the system I hate most. I already loathed the similar chaos system in the Dishonored series for locking down how I **** I’m playing GTA, why can’t I run wild alone until I drop dead, like a dog chasing cars?
